records.failureSummary:
Backend work for T-07 is complete: src/render.mjs implements renderTable(table, options) with an internal transformCell helper that coerces header and data cells to strings, replaces CRLF/CR/LF newlines with
, escapes every pipe, then trims, strictly in that mandatory order; separator entries are generated rather than transformed; each column width is max(3, longest transformed cell including the header) and every column including the last is right-padded; src/parse.mjs is untouched; npm run build and npm run lint pass. npm run test reports 39 tests with 38 passed and 1 failed. The single failure is a contradictory QA-owned test assertion: in test/render.cells.test.mjs the pipe test requires lines[2].split('|').length - 1 === 2, but a correctly rendered one-column row for cell a|b is pipe-delimited and therefore contains three pipe characters (leading delimiter, the escaped pipe, trailing delimiter), so 2 is impossible without violating AC-01 and AC-05, which require every rendered line to start and end with a pipe. The companion cell assertion in the same test (cellAt(result, 2, 0)) passes, proving the transform pipeline is correct. Per the change-only-backend-files rule I did not edit the QA-owned test; the failure can only be resolved by correcting that test assertion, so the plan must be re-derived.
